scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/desktop typecheck && tsc -p tests-e2e
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/desktop test && cargo test --workspace
scripts.lint:collect: sh scripts/test-prereqs.sh && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --message-format=json -- -D warnings > target/clippy.json
scripts.tauri:dev: bash apps/desktop/src-tauri/scripts/stage-sidecars.sh debug && OXPLOW_PROJECT_DIR="$PWD" bun run --cwd apps/desktop tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build:app: bun run --cwd apps/desktop tauri build --bundles app
